label: early-prefix token following o (sparse conjunctive code)
explanation: Fires sparsely (0.065% of steps) almost only in the original phase at steps 2-4 (peak t=3, 50% of mass) and at the delimiter for short sequences; never at t<2 or recall_idx>=2. Strongly enriched when the previous token (16x) or the one before that (13x) is o, and for current inputs 1, z, a, 3, k; also for first tokens s, z, 3. The strongest activations are prefixes such as 3 o o 1 and z o o 1. But each of these contexts is active only about 1% of the time, so this looks like a sparse code over specific short prefixes and not one describable property. The best predicate (prev token o at t 2-4 with input in {1,z,a,3,k,s,p}) reaches only dev F1 0.17. A broader prev/prev2-token rule covers 75% of mass at 4% precision. Magnitude is fairly flat (median 0.12, max 0.21); the top values are o o followed by 1.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=j (+4.32), prev_tok=a (+4.31), orig0=s (+4.23), prev2_tok=o (+4.17), prev_tok=o (+4.14), t=2 & prev_tok=o (+3.65). Lower it: phase=2 (-5.77), in_tok=f (-4.71), prev3_tok=s (-4.67), orig0=j (-2.84).
